let Dedup = system(
  var tries in 0..2
  var req in bool
  var applied in 0..2
  var seen in bool
  var reply in {none, flying, got}
  init tries = 0 ∧ req = false ∧ applied = 0 ∧ seen = false ∧ reply = none
  action send when tries < 2 ∧ req = false ∧ reply ≠ got do tries := tries + 1, req := true
  action lose when req = true do req := false
  action deliver when req = true ∧ seen = false do req := false, applied := applied + 1, seen := true, reply := flying
  action again when req = true ∧ seen = true do req := false, reply := flying
  action loseReply when reply = flying do reply := none
  action gotReply when reply = flying do reply := got
)
column3: = system({tries, req, applied, seen, reply}, {send, lose, deliver, again, loseReply, gotReply})   [14 reachable states]
